completion:
Have the employee complete an AutoCare partner benefit card form* and stick it in their wallet.
3. Get the employee to complete an Incident Report Form, which your insurer should provide.
4. Check the "Claims Assistance" website your insurer provides to accurately document the incident for your insurer.

The vast majority of people who have WCB claims or auto care partner benefit claims* can avoid long-term impairment. Proper diagnosis, treatment and/or assistance with the return-to-work process are critical to reducing the potential of long-term claims.

a) The correct date and time
b) The correct reason for treatment and/or workers compensation
c) The appropriate treatment method
